title: Good Tidings for Believers
body:
(Mawlana stands)
Yaa Rasulullah (s)! Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. Dastoor yaa Rasulullah (s).
As-salaamu `alaykum. O People, Muslims or non-Muslims, Christians and Jewish people and everyone. We
are all from the same tree, but different branches and different fruits. And the Lord of Heavens is just
planting that tree on this world for people to be happy here and to make their Lord happy with them forever.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Anta Rabbuna,
anta Rabbuna, anta Hasbuna, anta Waliyuna, anta Mawlana. La shareeka lah, no partner for You. You are
creating everything. Whoever is claiming that You have partners, all of them are no-mind people, and their
(mental) levels are under levels of animals.
We are giving our most high greetings to Your most beloved and glorified and honored one through Your
Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alayka ya Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa’laakhireen, every minute in every second and every time that we can reach it to be on you, yaa Rasulullah (s).
Yaa Habeebullah, yaa Nooru `Arshillah. Allah, Allah. Nooru `Arshillah. Despite the Wahabbis and Salafis,
Rasulullah (s) is Nooru `Arshillah.! We have been honored in such a way.

(Mawlana sits)
Hayy Hayy Hayy Hayy 4x
Hu Hu Hu Hu Hu 3x
Hayy Hayy Hayy Hayy
O our Master, Master of this planet, Master of dunya, Qutb of dunya! Support us to address our Lord's
servants. Look to us, and give Your heavenly support. If You are giving Your heavenly support, You can carry
this world through Your hands; ten more also, a hundred more also. O Qutb, the pole of this planet, can carry
hundreds and hundreds of such planets, as we know from knowing people that the solar system is under one
Master's command. Fa maa dhalika `alal'Lahi bi-`Azeez.
I am surprised at everything that we can't be able to understand. Adab of servants is to say, “Why not?” This
may be by a comparison of our thinking or imagination of power, that is something impossible. But if you are
thinking, qudratullah, endless Mighty Oceans of Allah Almighty, it is nothing! If He is saying to one servant
to carry the solar system, can't it be? How are you Muslim? How are you saying, innahu `ala kulli shayin
qadeer - that our Lord can do everything? If I am saying that one person is carrying the solar system, either
pulling or pushing, it is okay!
As-salaamu `alaykum our beloved listeners! Some of you are very happy; some are friends of Shaytan and
they are getting angry. It doesn't matter. If they are getting angry by Shaytan's order, then Shaytan is going to
hells. But whom are happy when Allah Almighty granted one deputy to carry the solar system, pulling or
pushing, that is just an acceptable servant whom Allah Almighty is giving that one capital. (Allah Almighty is
saying,) “Well done. You are thinking well, you are saying at least My maqdarah (ability, power). I am happy
with you.” Yes, you can carry the solar system.
If it is going to be too much for some people, I may say that holy one, one real servant, may carry our galaxy
or Milky Way. You know? Did you never hear about the Milky Way? In the summertime you are going to see
so many millions or billions of stars just spread in the skies. This they are saying, our galaxy, we are not
objecting on it, no, doesn't matter. You are saying that you are belonging to the solar system and in the solar
system is one of the stars of our galaxy, and is well known as the Milky Way galaxy. If someone is a weak

servant like me, and saying “I believe”, because it is a moving galaxy (and) not any galaxy is fixed. No one is
saying that one galaxy is fixed on its position through the heavens. They are moving, yes. If one of the
deputies of the Lord Allah (swt) may say to that galaxy, “Stop!” then it is going to stop, because a real deputy's
order is his Lord's order, and it must stop!
O mu'mins, believe! We are not playing. Give more distance for understanding realities in Islam and what the
Holy Qur'an is bringing. Allahu akbar, Huuu may stop it; He may be like a traffic police. If He is saying to
another gigantic galaxy, “Slowly, slowly, slowly,” until this galaxy may get on its way slowly. And saying to the
second one, “Slowly, take a little bit slowly, leave way, give way this,” it is in a hurry to reach on its limit, last
limit. “What is its last limit?” some clever ones may ask. Any limits? How are you Muslims? How are you
mu'mins and you are saying this? Any limit for a galaxy? How you are believing in God, Allah Almighty? O
Believers! You must believe that everything, physically or spiritually, is in limits. Unlimited is only for the
Creator, Allah Almighty, but everything has a limit. Therefore, that qutb may say, “Stop!” and this galaxy
must move to reach its limit, yes.
Allahu akbar. Maa `azhama shaanak yaa Rabbee. Allahu akbar maa `azhama shaanak. O our Lord, maa
`azhama shaanak. Subhaanak!
Sometimes granting to me some, that you are calling haal (spiritual state), giving. I can't carry myself; I am
getting full because they are making me to speak on ilaahiyaat, which means that it belongs to Allah
Almighty's Attributes. Everything has a limit. Where is it ending? Their limits are ending through the
dominion of endlessly oceans, unlimited oceans. They are running to that oceans, which is unlimited. It
belongs to the Lord of Heavens. They are running to those oceans. When they are reaching, they are finding
what they are asking for. That is something that great masters know - we don't know, yes. A raining running
through space, running to reach. If we are bringing an example, when there is a heavy rain on mountain,
rivers beginning to run, running, running, running until they reach the ocean. When coming in the ocean
they become silent; they found what they were asking. They are in no more struggling, no; they are reaching
the ocean and sleeping, and taking their rest. That is their matloob, last aim for them, to reach to the ocean.

SubhaanAllah! Yaa ayyuha 'l-insaan innaka kaadihun ila rabbika kadhan fa mulaqeeyah, sadaq-Allahu 'l`adheem.

••• •••••••• ••••••••••• ••••••• ••••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••••• ••••••••••••
Yaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa rabbika kadhan fa mulaaqiyyah.
You, verily, O Man, are working toward your Lord a work which you will meet (in His presence). (84:6)
Just Allah Almighty giving a real explanation for everything. Ayyuha 'l-insaan, O My deputies that I have
tashreef, honored to be My deputies! And when you are dressed in that honor, you are asking to reach to My
endless Dominion Oceans. Therefore, so many astronomers are saying galaxies are running from one
direction to another direction. Running, but they may say only by looking and new galaxies are appearing.
And for a while they are running, after which they disappear. Everything comes from Allah (swt) and
returning to Allah (swt). That is a very smart, very beautiful description. We are giving a description that
everything coming from oceans of the Lord's Dominions, Existence Oceans and they are running to reach
back to those Unlimited Oceans for Allah Almighty's divinely Dominion Oceans. That is a very important
subject that I don't know if pope heard about it, or Muslim `ulama living now understanding such very fine
points, or if rabbis are understanding such meanings.
May Allah (swt) forgive us and forgive me. They are making me to speak on it. I don't know, but they are
making me to speak. They are giving. It is not my thinking. I am not thinking and imagining and saying, “You
must believe in God.” O People! Sometimes the Lord of Heavens is making the weakest creature for
frightening you, yes. Now the whole world is trembling from fright. For what? Pig flu! It is making people to
tremble. Yes, He can do everything. What about a deputy? If a pig flu virus is making whole nations on this
planet to tremble and to be frightened, what about that qutb and holy ones who are servants of heavenly
levels? What can they do? Use your minds and try to understand heavenly wisdoms, O People! I am sorry to
say, including myself, whole people their interest is only for short-time pleasures on this planet and it is not
our real aspect from our Creation and to bring in existence. O People. Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah,
Subhaan Allah!
As-salaamu `alaykum, O People! Allah Almighty's endless Power Oceans, endless bahru 'l-qudrah, bahru 'l`azhamah, endless oceans of mighty, to be mighty. O People, if it was in limits, Man would pass away quickly
because they should feel that they are in prison, but now they are saying endless Mighty Oceans, endless
Rahmat Oceans, Mercy Oceans, Blessing Oceans for our Lord. They are feeling freshness or freedom for their

souls, and their minds are going to be full with heavenly lights.
O People! You are wasting your time, wasting your precious lives and leaving this life and going back and
knowing nothing. That is the biggest blame for Mankind! Therefore, time is over now and the Lord of
Heavens is asking to prepare their minds, or prepare their understanding to move a little bit for
understanding big realities, endless Reality Oceans. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar! Limits, there
must be limits, unlimited position are only for the Lord of Creation. Everything, they are in limits; know it!
But the Lord of Heavens is asking to grant to chosen servants another position through another worlds or
dominions and oceans, and that is the biggest good tidings for Mankind! And the Prophet (s) calling, “O
People, come. Come to me, come to me. I am making you to reach to such a positions and beings that no one
saw it before, no one heard it before, and no one tasted it before. I am giving you unexpected and unknown
and endless mighty beings dominions oceans!” Biggest good tidings!
O People! Try to move to heavens or you are going to be a handful of dust finally, never understanding and
never tasting. They may taste something also, but their tasting is never going, as man zaaka arab, whom are
tasting here. Whom are not tasting here, not going to be like those tasting here. Their dominions and oceans
(are) another, cheap; and dominions and oceans of those tasting, expensive. Run after expensive treasure,
endless treasures in the Divinely Presence.
O our Lord, forgive us; we know nothing! Our Lord, give Your mercy and forgiveness for Your weak servants.
I am the weakest one, O our Lord.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah.
Dome dome dome dome 4x
Allah Almighty is saying, fulki 'l-mashhoon. Our `ulama must know, must look. What does it mean, fulkil
mashhun? Now we are on fulk, like a ship, full with every kind of Creation, that Allah Almighty is saying, Wa
hamalna dhurriy-yatahum fi 'l-fulki 'l-mashhoon.
••••••• ••••••• •••••• ••••••••• •••••••••••••• ••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••
Wa aayatun lahum anna hamalna Wa hamalna dhurriy-yatahum fi 'l-fulki 'l-mashhoon.

And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship. (36:41)
To where? Think on it Wahabi and Salafi `ulama, think on it! What does it mean, fil fulkil mashhun, shufu
unzuru qutubut-tafaasir. Don't speak through your mind productions, no. Look at prophets, `ulama; look
and try to understand. Don't use your days, your lives (to say), “That is haram, that is shirk, that is bid'ah.”
Akbar bid'ah, that you are taking balance through your hands and saying, “That is a kafir, that is a mushriq,
that is harami, that is bid'ah.” Who is giving you that balance into your hands? Tell me! Ibn Taymiyya or
Qaymiya giving to you that balance? They are not knowing and believing that balance is in the hands of Allah
(swt)? You are mushriqs! You can't say for anyone, “That is a kafir,” or “That is a mushriq,” or “That is
bid'ah!” Allah (swt) is only ahkamu hakimeen, you are not ahkamu hakimeen, astaghfirullah!
Allah Allah, Allah Allah
Dome dome dome dome 4x
Let us, O our Lord, to hear the angels glorifying to Your Mighty Existence! They are saying and singing, “O
our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, forgive us. Forgive us, we are knowing nothing and we are so
useless servants! Forgive us, O our Lord. For the honor of that one, whom is the best one in Your Divine
Presence Sayyidina Muhammad (s).”
Fatihah. (46 minutes)
As He likes. O yaa Rabbee. Okay? As-salaamu `alaykum, O people. Make du'a for me. Allah, Allah. Thank you
for your listening. Fatihah.
